rule.name: PooledFieldNotReset
rule.message: This field of a pooled object (the class recycles itself through a Recycler or ObjectPool handle) is assigned after creation, but recycle never resets it and not every factory method assigns it, so the next borrower sees the value of the last use (a cached position, an initialized flag, a reference that keeps its owner alive). Reset it before handle.recycle(this) (this.position = null;), assign it in every factory method that takes an object from the pool, or reset it where the object is returned to the pool. An exception fits a field that every reader overwrites before reading it.
